# Presusimple

> Presusimple is a personal finance web app for zero-based budgeting, expense tracking, and monthly budget planning. Available in English and Spanish as a Progressive Web App (PWA).

Presusimple helps users assign every dollar (or peso) a job, track spending in real time, and visualize budgets with charts. Free tier includes core budgeting; Pro tier adds AI-powered budget creation and advanced features.

## Features

- Zero-based monthly budgeting
- Real-time expense tracking by category
- Spending charts and budget summaries
- Multi-currency support
- Progressive Web App (installable, offline-capable)
- English and Spanish UI
- Google OAuth and email/password authentication
- Pro subscription via Lemon Squeezy (AI budgeting, advanced features)

## Tech stack

- Next.js 15 (App Router), React 18, TypeScript
- MongoDB with Mongoose
- NextAuth.js
- Deployed on Vercel at https://www.presusimple.com

## API

REST API under `/api/` for budgets, expenses, categories, features, and billing webhooks. Swagger docs available at `/api-docs`.
